name: Cathedral of Light
promptTemplate: God rays breaking through a churning {{cloud_density}} cloud deck in a {{palette}} palette with {{ray_intensity}} beam radiance and {{wind_speed}} wind over {{landscape_style}}, illuminated dust {{dust_glint}}.

palette.hint: Shift sky glow and beam coloration

cloud_density.hint: Pack clouds tighter to narrow the gaps

ray_intensity.hint: Dial brightness of the piercing light shafts

wind_speed.hint: Accelerate cloud drift and beam motion

dust_glint.hint: Illuminate drifting specks caught in the beams

listing.blurb: Luminous god rays break through churning cloud decks over dark silhouettes, casting sweeping beams and glinting motes across the room.
listing.prompt: God rays: shafts of light breaking through a slowly churning cloud bank over a dark landscape, the beams sweeping as the gaps in the clouds open and close, dust glinting in them. Make it striking on a big projected wall in a dark room: a bold composition, rich colour against real blacks, depth, glow, and motion that reads from across the room. Keep a demoscener's economy: lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, low-resolution offscreen buffers for any per-pixel work, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
